attacks.name: Prototype Weapons
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical|, |!energy|, or |!mystic|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!wild| |*Hydra Ingenuity|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§shock§Shock|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§stun§Stun|.

attacks.name: Focused Esp Box Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character may Advance the defender |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

superPowers.name: Experimental Enhancements
superPowers.body: During the next attack made by this character this turn, add 2 dice to its attack roll. After the attack is resolved, if the attack roll contains any |!failure| results, this character suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Hydra Engineering
superPowers.body: While this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character is attacking or defending, during the Modify Dice step of the attack, this character may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, this character or the allied character may reroll 1 of their attack or defense dice.|\|After the attack is resolved, if the allied roll contained one or more |!failure| results, the allied character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Scientific Hubris
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least one |!critical|.
